proof_scope: live Chatterbox render analysis plus deterministic WAV fixture coverage for pause, prosody, intelligibility-input, and quality metrics

claims.proves: the skill analyzes a live Chatterbox render from waveform read-back, detects planned-vs-measured pause behavior, computes prosody/quality metrics, and writes inspectable JSON plus Markdown reports
claims.does_not_prove: human-perceived emotional quality, real speaker emotion, SpeechBrain/openSMILE availability, or full ASR fidelity unless a transcript is supplied

capability_claims.description: Evaluate generated Chatterbox audio as a waveform artifact with pause, prosody, intelligibility-input, and quality metrics.

cases.name: live-chatterbox-render-analysis-readback
command:
cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/analyze-chatterbox-emotions && ./run.sh fixture-wav --out /tmp/analyze-chatterbox-emotions-agentic.wav >/dev/null; ./scripts/render_live_chatterbox_sample.py --out-receipt /tmp/analyze-chatterbox-emotions-live-render.json --out-audio-path /tmp/analyze-chatterbox-emotions-live-audio-path.txt >/tmp/analyze-chatterbox-emotions-live-render.stdout; audio=$(cat /tmp/analyze-chatterbox-emotions-live-audio-path.txt); ./run.sh analyze --audio "$audio" --expected-text '[sniff] [sniff] ... give me a second. This is tender, and I can keep going.' --target-label tender --render-plan /tmp/analyze-chatterbox-emotions-live-render.json --out /tmp/analyze-chatterbox-emotions-live-analysis.json --report /tmp/analyze-chatterbox-emotions-live-analysis.md >/tmp/analyze-chatterbox-emotions-live-analysis.stdout; python3 - <<'PY2'
import json, pathlib
p=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/tmp/analyze-chatterbox-emotions-live-analysis.json').read_text())
assert p['schema']=='analyze_chatterbox_emotions.voice_eval.v1'
assert p['mocked'] is False and p['live'] is True
assert p['pauses']['planned_pause_count'] == 1
assert p['pauses']['measured_long_pause_count'] >= 1
assert p['quality']['clipping_fraction'] == 0
print('PASS_LIVE_CHATTERBOX_VOICE_ANALYSIS_READBACK')
PY2
